assumptions.basis: Steady state; 1 kg declared target product; Q and W positive into each block; no accumulation/KE/PE terms

assumptions.boundary: Inherited HTL fixed-background accounting: feed, heater/reactor electricity, fixed pump inventory, direct CO2/CH4 and wastewater; excludes separator heat duty and cooling-service burdens; not a full-plant utility inventory

balance.tolerance: Per block: max(0.01 kg/h, 0.1% mass throughput); max(0.01 kW, 0.1% absolute enthalpy/duty scale). Numerical consistency only.
